'''Prakrii''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[TIE pilot]], who was recently transferred to the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Imperial-class Star Destroyer]] [[Garrett (Star Destroyer)|''Garrett'']] as part of the [[Battle of Ottega]] to finish of [[Admiral Harkov's fleet]] that had defected to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. As the pilots were getting ready for the second stage of the battle, Prakrii was in a last minute exchange with another more experienced pilot [[Saaryu]] over their opinions of the [[TIE/Advanced starfighter|TIE Avenger's]] [[Tractor beam/Legends|Tractor beam]] and its use in battle.
